prompt:
GAME ITEM SPRITE. One single object seen from above at a slight angle, centred, like an item lying on the ground in a top-down strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga vehicle solar panel kit: a rigid solar panel for a camping vehicle's roof, with its charge controller. Image 1 is our approved house battery from the same family of camping kits: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape or colour.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 80 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A flat rectangular solar panel lying face up, in a slim silver aluminium frame with four small mounting brackets at its corners; its face a deep blue-black grid of cells, six by ten, with thin pale lines between them and a faint soft sheen; beside its frame, a small grey charge controller box with two short coiled cables, one red and one black.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No people, text, letters, numbers, plus or minus signs, logos, brand marks, dials, screens, lights, sparks, sun or shadow beyond the object.
